verdict.rationale: The product's core interaction is natural language. Tasks are submitted as plain-English scientific questions (e.g. "Which neglected diseases had a treatment developed by artificial intelligence?"), and Kosmos takes a research objective and works autonomously from it. Chat sessions add multi-turn conversation with an agent that keeps its history and workspace across turns. Missing for 10: no evidence that platform operations (data upload, job management, token setup) can be driven by natural language rather than SDK code or UI clicks, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the conversational experience.
